summary_1line: After Rama slays the demon army, Shurpanakha goes to Lanka and reproaches Ravana, urging him to confront Rama.

image_candidates.scene_text: Shurpanakha, shrieking in fury, stands before Ravana on his golden throne surrounded by ministers in the palace of Lanka.
Ravana with ten heads and twenty arms sits blazing like a sacrificial fire on a golden throne, scarred from battles with gods.
The demon king’s massive form adorned with gold and emeralds towers like a mountain in the royal hall of Lanka.
